cases.procedure: Run reviewed Cardo qualification media-lifetime.py with --seconds16 --transport file in an owned PTY and independent memory guard; repeat compressed path separately
assertions: No image deletion before replacement completes
Zero leases and images after shutdown

cases.procedure: Run inline-video, inline-image, media-live, watermarks, diagnostics and retina-geometry qualification scenes against the exact candidate
assertions: Copy/selection preserved across playback and scrub
Restore time/zoom/audio/playing intent after session switch

cases.procedure: zterm2 owns isolated CPU/GPU comparisons using identical sRGB/DisplayP3/alpha fixtures, then a bounded native terminal integration run
assertions: Colour and alpha within explicit measured tolerance
No GPU resource overwritten while in flight
Texture count/bytes bounded across resize and hidden media
Generation changes update pixels without stale cache
cases.evidence: Acceptance criteria proposed for zterm2; no completed receiver qualification claimed

cases.procedure: Check standard iTerm2, local zterm2, SSH, Zellij and SSH+Zellij separately with actual end-to-end probes
assertions: No local SHM under SSH/multiplexer assumptions
Copy support verified separately from image support
cases.evidence: Acceptance matrix; not a claim that all combinations have passed

data.colourReference: Compare CPU and GPU outputs under the same source/target colour profile and alpha policy; record tolerances and maximum error, including transparent pixels. These inputs are not an assertion of correct output colours.
